//: Everything tsconfig.json leaves out. That one excludes src/**/*.test.ts -- a leftover from when tspc emitted it into lib/ and a shipped test file would have gone out with the Lambda; esbuild bundles from an entry point instead, so it no longer matters -- which leaves the tests and the regression suite with no project of their own, and the `src/*` path alias unresolved in them. vite-tsconfig-paths reads this file instead, and `npm run typecheck` checks both.
